question: Does dyadic refinement of the existing hydraulic vertical support, without adding any root-specific state, systematically reduce the independently diagnosed A and B components of the R16 Feddes functional error on the same qualified RA02R states, and what coarsest static support reaches the frozen numerical distinguishability guard?

support_sweep.justification: Each support is an exact dyadic subdivision of the already tested R16 10 cm support and aligns exactly with the qualified 2048-node Reference grid. Values are fixed before D2 response.

functionals.root_head_for_support: F_roothead(d) = sum_i DeltaF_i alpha(sum_{j in i} w_j h_j / DeltaF_i)

metrics_per_support: transaction RMSE and max absolute E
transaction RMSE and max absolute A
transaction RMSE and max absolute B
fraction of transactions with h3/h4 crossing in at least one rooted retained layer
sum of absolute layerwise total error in crossing and non-crossing layers

numerical_distinguishability.frontier_definition: For each case and component, the frontier is the coarsest preregistered support whose maximum absolute fractional functional error is <= guard. The all-case frontier is the coarsest support satisfying that condition in all eight cases.
numerical_distinguishability.boundary: This is an arithmetic/reference distinguishability frontier, not an application tolerance.

interpretation_rules.refinement_collapses_A: A max-absolute error decreases with support refinement and reaches the numerical guard at some preregistered support.
interpretation_rules.refinement_collapses_B: B max-absolute error decreases with support refinement and reaches the numerical guard at some preregistered support.
interpretation_rules.pure_hydraulic_support_can_represent_sta: Total E reaches the numerical guard in all eight cases without root-specific state.
interpretation_rules.root_specific_information_efficiency_que: Even if sufficiently fine hydraulic support reaches the guard, D2 does not establish that such a representation is dynamically useful or efficient.

prohibited: No new root-specific state or memory variable.
No adaptive or response-selected layer boundaries.
No fitted coefficient or error correction.
